answer: Persistent key-streak tally. Each identity carries a sable-marked key history; agents must sign consecutive epochs with the same key, and any gap or key swap resets the streak. Rewards and task access unlock only past a streak threshold, so a fresh duplicate starts at zero. An attacker must keep every clone signing and paying per-epoch opal fees for the whole ramp period before it earns anything. Cross-checks flag lotus-like clusters of synchronized new keys.
